 Grand Theft Auto VI is out – which audiences are generating the most brand Buzz?
 Stephan Shakespeare - 20 November 2026 This week marks the release of Grand Theft Auto VI , the latest instalment in Rockstar Games’ beloved – and occasionally controversial – blockbuster franchise.
 Over the past year, YouGov BrandIndex data shows that the Grand Theft Auto series was second only to Super Mario Bros . in terms of perceived quality (22.6 vs. 23.4), satisfaction (15.4 vs. 19.6), and recommendation (19.7 vs. 12.6).
 Recent YouGov Surveys polling also highlights the sheer reach of the franchise among Britons: one in three say they’ve played a version of it at some point or another (33%), and one in six (17%) say they are likely to play the new title. This rises notably – to approaching three in five (58%) – among men aged 18-34.
 YouGov BrandIndex data shows that if the franchise’s marketing is targeting men aged 18-34, it appears to be working. Grand Theft Auto’s Ad Awareness scores – which measure whether consumers have recently seen an advertisement for the game in the past two weeks – rose 11.3 points in the past year, going from 3.8 last November to 15.1 now. However, among younger men, these scores jumped even more – rising from 10.4 to 39.5.
 Grand Theft Auto VI’ s marketing campaign seems to have successfully increased the franchise’s appeal among both the wider public and the audience it has historically cultivated. For instance, over the past 12 months its Consideration score among the UK public rose from 15.3 to 17.2 – but moved more among younger men, increasing from 29.6 to 42.2. However, the data also points to the franchise seeing its numbers improve among women aged 18-34. Here, Grand Theft Auto’s Ad Awareness scores increased from 4.8 to 21.2 and its consideration of the franchise rose from 17.3 to 20.5.
 The new GTA was perhaps always going to be a hit, but whether due to targeted marketing or the addition of a female protagonist, the franchise’s appeal appears to be growing beyond its traditional audience.
